about.heading: Hi, This is Nafiz
about.lead: Hello! I am Md. Nafizur Rahman, a dedicated Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) student at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, University of Rajshahi, Bangladesh.
bioParagraphs: My academic journey is built upon a strong foundation in Anatomy, Histology, Physiology, Pathology, Parasitology, Microbiology, Medicine, Surgery, Epidemiology, and Public Health. I am deeply passionate about bridging the gap between biological research and advanced computational science to improve animal welfare, public health, and disease prevention.

Throughout my journey, I have integrated traditional veterinary science with modern Data Analytics, developing proficiency in Python, SQL, and data visualization tools like GeoPandas and Matplotlib to drive evidence-based research.

My research experience and focus areas include: Clinical Surveillance & Antimicrobial Stewardship evaluating veterinary prescribing patterns, owner KAP (Knowledge, Attitude, and Practices), and self-medication behaviors in companion animals in Rajshahi; Nanomedicine & Computational Biology leading a registered systematic review and meta-analysis on nanoparticle-based Rabies vaccines; and Epidemiology & Parasitology examining ectoparasite dynamics in free-roaming dogs in the Barind Tract, Cimex spp. bedbug infestation risks in university halls, and molecular characterization of Capillaria spp. in native poultry.

Beyond academics, I am an active advocate for animal welfare. I regularly participate in hands-on snake rescue operations with Save Wildlife and Nature (SWAN), Bangladesh, and dedicate time to providing free clinical services for stray and campus animals. I am eager to connect with professionals and researchers in veterinary medicine, nanomedicine, and public health under the One Health framework.

scientificResearch.title: Comparative Immunogenicity, Protective Efficacy, and Safety of Nanoparticle-Based Rabies Vaccines in Mice
scientificResearch.summary: Synthesizing preclinical in vivo murine data following PRISMA guidelines using a Random-Effects Model to evaluate Virus-Neutralizing Antibody (VNA) kinetics, post-challenge survival rates, and platform-specific safety profiles across mRNA-LNPs, VLPs, lipopolyplexes, and nano-adjuvants.

scientificResearch.title: Clinical Surveillance and Antimicrobial Stewardship in Companion Animals (Rajshahi)
scientificResearch.institution: Faculty of Veterinary & Animal Sciences, University of Rajshahi
scientificResearch.summary: A 12-month prospective clinical surveillance investigating veterinary prescribing patterns, clinical syndrome frequencies, owner Knowledge, Attitude, and Practices (KAP), and hazardous home self-medication behaviors across private practices in Rajshahi.

scientificResearch.title: Epidemiology and Distribution of Ectoparasites in Free-Roaming Dogs (Barind Tract)
scientificResearch.institution: Faculty of Veterinary & Animal Sciences, University of Rajshahi
scientificResearch.summary: Sampled 310 free-roaming dogs, collected 2,908 ectoparasites, established the first morphological records of Ctenocephalides orientis and Heterodoxus spiniger in Bangladesh, and conducted COX1/18S rRNA molecular sequencing of Haemaphysalis bispinosa and Dermacentor ticks.

scientificResearch.title: Species Distribution and Risk Factors of Bedbug (Cimex spp.) Infestation in Student Residences
scientificResearch.summary: Cross-sectional survey evaluating infestation rates, environmental sanitation risk factors, and sleep disturbances across a 370-bed cohort in high-density student residences.

scientificResearch.title: Save Wildlife and Nature (SWAN) Bangladesh Operations
scientificResearch.summary: Participating in emergency snake rescue (venomous/non-venomous), reptile rehabilitation, raptor release, and community biodiversity coexistence drives across Rajshahi and Northern Bangladesh.

scientificResearch.title: Molecular Characterization and Histopathology of Capillaria spp. in Native Poultry
scientificResearch.institution: Dept. of Veterinary & Animal Sciences, University of Rajshahi
scientificResearch.summary: Investigating prevalence, histopathological lesions in the crop and esophagus, and molecular sequencing of Capillaria spp. infecting indigenous backyard scavenging chickens in the Barind agro-ecological zone.

softwareProjects.name: PoultryMedix: Autonomous Multimodal AI for Avian Health & AMR Stewardship
softwareProjects.description: It's an AI-driven veterinary diagnostic and epidemiological platform designed for marginal poultry farmers in Bangladesh. Rooted in the 'One Health' framework, it utilizes multi-modal AI to accurately diagnose poultry diseases and actively combat Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) by enforcing medication withdrawal periods through automated prescription scanning.

softwareProjects.name: ZunSync (Evidentara): Reproducible AI Research Platform
softwareProjects.description: An evidence-grounded computational research workbench engineered for veterinary epidemiologists, One Health scientists, and molecular researchers, featuring end-to-end data provenance tracking, literature synthesis pipelines, and Dockerized reproducibility.

softwareProjects.name: Zun Synthesis Academy (ZSA) Web Platform
softwareProjects.description: Official repository for Zun Synthesis Academy—a premium ed-tech platform bridging biology and technology. Built with a scalable Python backend and Tailwind CSS frontend, offering dynamic programs in Bioinformatics, Data Analytics, and AI-Powered Research & Vibe Coding. Founded by Md. Nafizur Rahman.

softwareProjects.name: Professor's Vet & Pet Care Clinic Website
softwareProjects.description: A robust Django webapp / website for 'Professor's Vet & Pet Care'. It seamlessly combines a veterinary clinic management system (doctor bookings, surgery gallery, schedules) with a pet e-commerce store (medicines, real-time POS inventory). Features a responsive UI, theme toggle, and powerful admin panel. Supervised by Dr. Abdulla Al Mamun Bhuyan (Associate Professor, RU).
